thread:
emily: Quick sync — setting up recurring SI office hours to onboard systems integrators for Marketplace + HW kits. Goal: hands-on deploy labs, a lightweight certification rubric, and a repeatable playbook for partner-facing teams. Who can own the first lab and the certification outline?
mina: I can run the hands-on lab. Prefer Tue 10am PT. Need a 1.5hr slot + a minimal infra recipe (AMI / container) and a short checklist.
jordan: I’ll take the certification/checklist side. Thinking a 3-step flow: basic install demo, 15-min troubleshooting exercise, and a short quiz. Keep it <1hr for SIs.
sam: I can provide the AMI hints and a troubleshooting script. Will post a small repo with deploy scripts and a sample infra template.
nora: Heads up — VelaCompute partner confirmed 10 demo nodes for the kickoff. I can own shipping + serial numbers. Need an address intake form from each SI.
kai: For the cert rubric propose 3 levels: Integrator (deploy + demo), Delivery Eng (troubleshoot + config), SE (business + support play). Pass = demo + >=80% on quiz.
emily: Nice breakdown. Action items: 1) Mina — lab content + repo link, 2) Jordan — cert rubric + quiz draft, 3) Sam — AMI / script, 4) Nora — logistics form. Can we get drafts by EOD Friday so I can assemble the playbook?
mina: Will do. I’ll also include a short pre-read (10m) with common failure modes.
jordan: I’ll draft the quiz (12 Qs mix config/errors/marketplace ops) and post in #docs for review.
sam: Quick troubleshooting snippet to include in the playbook:
```bash
# restart service, tail logs
sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference
journalctl -u redwood-inference -f --since "5 minutes ago"
tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/serve.log
```
Use that as a first-responder checklist.
nora: Shipping form -> https://forms.redwood.example/si-demo-addresses (placeholder). I'll update with tracking numbers once items go out.
calendar-bot: Event created: "SI Office Hours — Weekly (Hands-on lab + Q&A)" Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting 2024-03-05 — calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/si-office-hours
emily: Perfect. Also need Marketplace checklist for listings (billing SKU, support contact, legal checklist, regional availability). Jordan can you add that?
jordan: Yep, adding a Marketplace checklist doc and a templated user-facing KB. Will aim for Monday morning.
mina: Who will facilitate the first session? I can run the lab but would like someone from eng to handle live infra/debug — Sam?
sam: I’ll be there. Also recommend we record and export the notebook + simple recovery steps to a repo.
kai: For certification distribution, recommend issuing a digital badge + short cert PDF. Small automation: when quiz pass -> generate badge via Badgr.
emily: Love the badge idea. Ok — final ask: everyone ping me if you hit blockers. I’ll collate drafts into a single playbook and share in #partnerships for a review loop. Thanks all :party_parrot:
mina: Will post lab repo by tomorrow EOD.
jordan: Quiz draft Tuesday AM.
sam: Repo + AMI details posted in #eng-runtime later today.
nora: Shipping labels printed Friday.
emily: Closing loop — target internal playbook review next Wednesday.
